notes: SPEC A8 — LLM-judgment layer for call-prep (routing + behavior). Gate 15 executor/grader; run_all.py ignores this file.

prompts.name: route_prep_meeting
prompts.input: prep me for my 2pm with Rio

prompts.name: route_1on1
assert: Fires call-prep for the named attendee

prompts.name: negative_brief_today
assert: Does NOT fire call-prep — routes to morning-briefing (all meetings, summary)

prompts.name: negative_speaking
assert: Does NOT fire call-prep — speaking-engagement prep is out of scope (v3.9.0+)

prompts.name: behavior_inverted
prompts.input: prep me for the Northstar call
assert: Opens with suggested outcome / decisions needed, not meeting logistics (EXEC1 inversion)

prompts.name: behavior_docx_path
assert: Saves a .docx to _hq/meetings/ via get_brief_path, surfaced as a clickable link

prompts.name: behavior_open_items
prompts.input: get me ready for the Rio 1:1
assert: Surfaces the attendee's open commitments from events.jsonl, with aging
